invariants.description: B-spline effort is a partition of unity inside the spline support: P_d is a convex combination of the control points
P_mus = P_d P_d_multiplier alpha (alpha = alpha_P_mus when flag_P_mus_control = 1, else 1)
mouth volume balance: C_m P_m changes by the time integral of v_vm - v_mt - v_leak (after the 0.5 s start-up transient)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((C_m*P_m - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((v_vm - v_mt - v_leak)[1:] + (v_vm - v_mt - v_leak)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5] - (C_m*P_m - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((v_vm - v_mt - v_leak)[1:] + (v_vm - v_mt - v_leak)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5][0])) <= 2e-3*max(np.ptp(C_m*P_m[t >= 0.5]), 1e-12) + 1e-12

invariants.description: airway volume balance: q_t + q_b + q_A changes by the time integral of the mouth-to-trachea flow v_mt (after 0.5 s)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(((q_t + q_b + q_A) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((v_mt)[1:] + (v_mt)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5] - ((q_t + q_b + q_A) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((v_mt)[1:] + (v_mt)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5][0])) <= 2e-3*np.ptp((q_t + q_b + q_A)[t >= 0.5]) + 1e-9

invariants.description: leak flow is zero below the threshold and non-negative

bc_sweep.rationale: Set pressure (CPAP/PEEP) 0-20 cmH2O, effort scaling 0-2x (apnoeic to strong effort) and rate -0.08..+0.3 /s, resistance split and compliance fractions over plausible ranges; the rest uses the default 0.5-2x factors around the placeholders.
